client_id.description: The Client ID used to identify the application.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description:
Specifies the authentication method for the `/token` endpoint.

Currently, only `tls_client_auth` is supported.

tls_client_auth_dn.description: Distinguished name (DN) of the transport certificate used by the [TPP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary).

id_token_signed_response_alg.description: The signing algorithm used to sign the `id_token` JWTs. Currently, only `PS256` is supported.

request_object_signing_alg.description: The signing algorithm used to sign request objects. Currently, only `PS256` is supported.

redirect_uris.description: List of the registered URIs that the [TPP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary) will use to interact with the [ASPSP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary).

org_jwks_endpoint.description: Public URI endpoint where the [TPP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary) has uploaded their JWKS in JSON format.

org_name.description: Legal Entity Identifier or other known organisation name.

scope.description:
List of scopes that the [TPP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary) has access to, provided as a **space-separated string**.
For example, `"openid accounts payments"`.
Possible scopes to list: `openid`, `accounts`, `payments`, `fundsconfirmation`.
